run_pretraining_app: run the pre-training app by calling scaffold.main with app name, args, and optional resume flag
resume_pretraining: resume a preempted pre-training run by passing resume_preempt=True to scaffold.main
import_train_module: import a module's train.main function dynamically via importlib for a given app name
configure_logging: configure root logger with INFO level outputting to stdout via logging.basicConfig
dispatch_app_training: dispatch training execution to app.{app}.train.main with args and resume_preempt parameters
